mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN file_status = '已通过' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inParkCount, SUM(CASE WHEN file_status != '已通过' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outParkCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN file_status = '已通过' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS checkPassRate FROM enterprise_file
SELECT enterprise_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM enterprise_file GROUP BY enterprise_type ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT enterprise_scale AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM enterprise_file GROUP BY enterprise_scale ORDER BY value DESC
